summary:
Comprehensive plan to elevate Yaatri to a 10/10 hackathon-winning application. Includes:
1. Interactive 24-Hour Timeline Scrubber synchronized with Leaflet Map markers and sky lighting.
2. Live Destination Weather & transit distance/time calculator between stops.
3. Bilingual Audio Guide player with Web Speech Synthesis (Kannada & English narration) and waveform visualizer.
4. Live Budget Expense Tracker with multi-currency conversion (INR, USD, EUR, GBP) and group split bill calculator.
5. Curated Karnataka Food Trail & authentic eatery cards with local specialties.
6. Smart Packing & Culture Checklist with interactive progress tracking.
